name: Interior lighting design
intro: Light a room from the luminaires' photometry files: the mean, lowest and highest lux on the workplane, uniformity, glare, walls and ceiling, and watts per square metre, with the light bounced off the room's surfaces. A design aid: check it against the standard and your own judgement.
host.none: This app has no rooms or drawing to read from. Type the outline below.
room.none: No closed shapes found. Select one, or type the outline below.
room.outline: Outline (x, y in millimetres, one corner per line)
lum.generic: A typical figure for this kind of luminaire, not a maker's: load the maker's file for a real design.
mode.plan.note: Finds the fewest luminaires, in an even grid, that reach the mean lux (and uniformity) you type.
mode.grid.note: Luminaires in an even grid: one in the middle of each cell of the room.
mode.rows.note: Rows of luminaires, evenly spread, along the room's x or y direction.
preset.workshop.medium: Workshop: medium bench and machine work
draw.done: Drew {n} luminaires and the lux values.
map.alt: Lux on the workplane, dark blue lowest to yellow highest, luminaires as white dots
map.note: Lux on the workplane: dark blue lowest, yellow highest ({max} lx).
note.model: Direct light from the luminaires' photometry plus the light bounced off floor, walls and ceiling as diffuse reflectors. No furniture, columns or inner walls block light, no windows or daylight: a room that is not a simple box is a little too bright in its bays.
note.llf: Lux are maintained values: the light loss factor is applied to every figure.
note.ugr: UGR is an estimate from the CIE 117 formula with the luminaires' candela and luminous opening, at initial flux, for four observers at 1.2 m: compare it with the maker's own UGR table.
note.opening: A photometry file gave no luminous opening, so 0.1 × 0.1 m was assumed for the glare figure.
err.room: The outline needs at least three corners that enclose some area.
err.height: The ceiling height must be between 0.5 and 60 m.
err.workplane: The workplane must be below the ceiling.

err.plan.max: No even grid of up to 400 luminaires reaches that. The best one tried: {n} luminaires, {em} lx. Choose a stronger luminaire or lower the target.

note.daylight: Drita e ditës: qielli standard i mbuluar i CIE-së, dritarja e ndarë në qeliza të vogla, drita që hyn e reflektuar mes sipërfaqeve të dhomës. Pa reflektim nga toka, pa ndërtesa, pemë apo streha jashtë, pa diell; xhami kalon të njëjtën pjesë drite në çdo kënd; pa korniza, shufra apo perde.
note.daylight2: Hapja e dritares lë dritë të dalë gjithashtu, prandaj muri pas xhamit nuk reflekton asgjë. Faktori i dritës natyrale është vetëm drita e ditës: nuk shtohet me dritën elektrike mbi të.
note.obstruct: Mobiljet dhe ndarjet bllokojnë vetëm dritën e drejtpërdrejtë; drita e reflektuar kalon nëpër to. Pikat brenda një kutie përjashtohen. Pas një kutie dhoma shfaqet pak më e ndriçuar, kurrë më e errët.
note.emergency: Ndriçimi i emergjencës: drita e drejtpërdrejtë në dysheme vetëm nga armaturat në qarkun e emergjencës, me prodhimin e tyre të emergjencës. Drita e reflektuar nga muret dhe tavani shpërfillet.
note.emergency2: Kufijtë janë vlera tipike sipas stilit të EN 1838, të pakontrolluara me edicionin aktual dhe në pritje të një inxhinieri të ndriçimit. Shenjat, kohëzgjatja dhe koha e kalimit nuk kontrollohen.

err.noemergency: Asnjë armaturë nuk është në qarkun e emergjencës.
